_comment: Endur'O figures are hand-entered. Endur'O is not on mWater, so nothing here can be derived from an extract - which is a fact about the programme, not a fault. What IS a fault is these figures ageing silently, so every one of them carries the date it was established, who established it, and the document it came from. tools/render_enduro.py writes them into index.html; tools/figure_census.py accepts a rendered literal as sourced only if it appears here.
